summary: Frontend-only regression testing passed the requested Discovery icon, sticky/internal-scrolling sidebar, 12-module Playground, module and breadcrumb selection, all seven step states, Break visual, action cycling, mobile drawer, unique test IDs, and overflow checks.
seed_data_creation: None; curriculum and Playground content are local data. The experiment is a LOCAL UI SIMULATION with no hardware or API integration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop tested at 1920x1080 and mobile at 390x844. Long Level 5 curriculum produced an internal scroll range; Playground module 12 and mobile drawer selection were covered.
rca of the issue: The prior desktop nav sizing concern is resolved by the current 100vh-constrained flex sidebar and sticky positioning. The initial Break assertion was a test-ordering false positive; an explicit Break rerun verified label BREAK, .signal.broken, ERROR / coba lagi, and the visible Challenge strip.
